criteria.criterion: Bally's pays for Upwards memberships for Bally’s Bronx employees
required_elements: Bally's funds employee membership to the Upwards network
the covered employees include Bally’s Bronx employees
criteria.promise_scope: Bally's says it funds every employee membership to the Upwards network, and the same source set states the childcare offering includes Bally’s Bronx employees; beneficiaries are employees including Bally’s Bronx employees; location is tied to Bally’s Bronx employees, while the general membership statement itself is not site-specific.
criteria.observed_scope: “We fund every employee membership to the Upwards network” “we have partnered with Upwards, the largest childcare network in the United States”
criteria.explanation: The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
criteria.gap: The excerpts do not tie an observed occurrence to the promised scope.

occurrence_witness.action_quote: We fund every employee membership to the Upwards network

entailment_check.incomplete_delivery_alternative: The statement reports that Bally's funds employee memberships, but it does not specifically say within this quote that the covered employees include Bally’s Bronx employees, so full scoped delivery to that locked subgroup is not independently established by the delivery witness alone.
entailment_check.observed_fact: Bally’s states, in the present tense, that it funds every employee membership to the Upwards network, and elsewhere says its childcare offering includes Bally’s Bronx employees.

criteria.criterion: Upwards membership gives Bally’s Bronx employees priority placement at Upwards facilities
required_elements: the funded Upwards membership carries priority placement at Upwards facilities
the priority placement benefit applies to the covered employees including Bally’s Bronx employees
criteria.promise_scope: Bally's represented that employee Upwards memberships confer priority placement at Upwards facilities for employees, including Bally’s Bronx employees under the cited childcare partnership. The benefit is priority eligibility or placement preference, not a guaranteed childcare slot.
criteria.observed_scope: Bally’s says members receive priority placement at Upwards facilities, and separately says it partnered with Upwards to offer childcare options including for Bally’s Bronx employees.
criteria.explanation: The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
criteria.gap: Bally’s could have partnered with Upwards and described that members receive priority placement at Upwards facilities, including for Bally’s Bronx employees, while zero Bally’s Bronx employees actually had funded Upwards memberships with that priority-placement benefit available to them.

entailment_check.zero_delivery_alternative: Bally’s could have partnered with Upwards and described that members receive priority placement at Upwards facilities, including for Bally’s Bronx employees, while zero Bally’s Bronx employees actually had funded Upwards memberships with that priority-placement benefit available to them.
entailment_check.incomplete_delivery_alternative: Even if some Bally’s employees could receive priority placement through Upwards membership, the cited passages do not directly establish that this benefit actually took effect for the locked scope of Bally’s Bronx employees.
entailment_check.observed_fact: Bally’s says members receive priority placement at Upwards facilities, and separately says it partnered with Upwards to offer childcare options including for Bally’s Bronx employees.

trace.verdict: The available evidence does not establish delivery of the requested obligation.

Upwards membership gives Bally’s Bronx employees priority placement at Upwards facilities
Status: UNVERIFIED
The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
Promised scope: Bally's represented that employee Upwards memberships confer priority placement at Upwards facilities for employees, including Bally’s Bronx employees under the cited childcare partnership. The benefit is priority eligibility or placement preference, not a guaranteed childcare slot.
Observed scope: Bally’s says members receive priority placement at Upwards facilities, and separately says it partnered with Upwards to offer childcare options including for Bally’s Bronx employees.
Evidence gap: Bally’s could have partnered with Upwards and described that members receive priority placement at Upwards facilities, including for Bally’s Bronx employees, while zero Bally’s Bronx employees actually had funded Upwards memberships with that priority-placement benefit available to them.
Promise evidence: c2, c3, c4
Context evidence: c2, c3

Cited source excerpts (promise, delivery, or context as assessed above):
c1: “We fund every employee membership to the Upwards network and offer financial assistance to ease the burden of childcare costs. This includes contributing to a Dependent Care FSA or providing "credits" for free childcare days.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf

c2: “Members also receive priority placement at Upwards facilities, which are plentiful near our proposed sites, and the program is increasingly popular among our employees.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf

c3: “To assist our working families, we have partnered with Upwards, the largest childcare network in the United States, to offer high-quality childcare options including for Bally’s Bronx employees.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf

c4: “Bally’s committed to pay for employees’ membership in Upwards, which would give the employee priority childcare placement in Upwards’ vetted facilities, but little information was provided about what membership entails or whether Upwards’ network facilities are already at capacity.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/gaming-facility-location-board-final-report-and-findings-march-2026

c5: “The Board recommends the Commission require Bally’s to provide annual updates on employee participation in the Upwards membership program for childcare and to address any challenges employees face in accessing convenient daycare options.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/gaming-facility-location-board-final-report-and-findings-march-2026

c6: “Childcare Services: Free childcare support for employees through our Upwards partnership”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/evalloc4.ballys.communities_redacted.pdf
